_doc: ALMA Science Archive metadata harvested 2026-09-11 for every execution block searched here. obscore (ivoa.obscore, asdm_uid) gives the antenna array and synthesised beam; the datalink service gives the raw ASDM progenitors of each member OUS, which obscore does not expose. frequency_support carries the archive-reported effective spectral resolution, i.e. the online Hanning/averaging state. | v3.80 (2026-09-19): re-harvested for the completed sweep, 482 blocks. obscore asdm_uid is not a complete per-EB index, so blocks it does not carry were resolved through their member OUS, whose spectral setup is the same; the source is recorded per block in meta_src. | v3.80: two Band 9/10 blocks were resolved through their member OUS, which returned the wrong array; the direct antenna census in b910_array_v363.json overrides it.
